definitions.explanation: The arteries that wrap around the heart and supply it with blood. When one becomes blocked, the result can be a heart attack ({心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}).

examples.japanese: {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}が{詰|つ}まる。
{冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}の{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had my coronary arteries examined.

examples.japanese: {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}が{狭|せま}くなると、{心臓|しんぞう}に{十分|じゅうぶん}な{血液|けつえき}が{届|とど}かなくなる。
examples.english: When the coronary arteries narrow, the heart can no longer receive enough blood.

notes:
The arteries surrounding the heart that supply it with blood; a blockage can cause a heart attack.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}が{詰|つ}まる: a coronary artery becomes blocked
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}{疾患|しっかん}: coronary artery disease
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}バイパス{手術|しゅじゅつ}: coronary bypass surgery
